source: measured transition/animation computed styles + @keyframes rules across 34 routes x 3 breakpoints; tokens.css itself ships no motion tokens

easings.value: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)

namedKeyframes.hero-globe-scale: scale(1)+opacity(1) end state - hero globe/graphic entrance
namedKeyframes.ach-show: max-height + scale/opacity reveal - accordion-style row expand (ACH returns/disputes UI)
namedKeyframes.fadeIn: opacity 0->1 with perspective rotateY - card flip-in
namedKeyframes.fadeInUp: opacity 0->1, paired with a translateY transition on the same element
namedKeyframes.scale-pattern-animation-two: opacity 1->0->1 - decorative dot-pattern shimmer (phase B, inverse of phase A)
namedKeyframes.swipe: background-position sweep with opacity fade - shimmer/skeleton-loading sweep
namedKeyframes.dotFadeOutIn: opacity+scale pulse via --dot-inactive-opacity/--dot-inactive-scale custom properties - carousel/stepper dot indicator

reducedMotion: tokens.css defines a global @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) block forcing animation-duration/transition-duration to 0.01ms and scroll-behavior to auto on every element.
